description: Scores how ready a business's operational data is to be licensed to data buyers (0-100), using only multiple-choice answers about the business and its records. Returns a factor-by-factor breakdown, the buyer types most likely to want those data types, red flags (privacy, consent, history length) and next steps. Use when someone asks whether their company's data could be sold or licensed, or what it would take. Does not estimate a dollar value, make an offer, contact anyone, or store answers. Do not send names, contact details, patient information or the data itself.

contains_health_info.description: True if any records include health or patient information. Only a yes/no flag; never send the information itself. Optional.

contains_personal_info.description: Whether the records include personal information about customers or other people. Optional.

data_flow.description: Whether new records keep arriving daily or the data is mostly historical.

data_types.description: Kinds of records the business keeps.

hq_region.description: Region of the business's headquarters (used only for privacy-law flags). Optional.

same_core_systems_years.description: How long the main business software systems have been in place. Optional.

sells_to.description: Whether the business sells to other businesses, consumers or both. Optional.

years_of_records.description: How many years of consistent records the business has.

name: check_data_readiness
title: Check data readiness
